query: How does interferon-gamma activate inflammatory gene expression in human macrophages?

runtime_config.query_budget_guidance:
Generate AT MOST {max_queries} complementary queries, spent as follows (recall over precision — a downstream filter handles precision):
- AT MOST ~2/5 of them as recall queries — broad plain-text baselines, no field tags, core concepts joined with OR synonyms. Your recall safety net. Keep them genuinely different: vary the phrasing and the synonym set, do not re-emit one query three ways.
- AT MOST ~2/5 of them as coverage queries — distinct angles on the question: a different synonym set, a related sub-concept, or a different field/entity from the syntax reference below. One concept each, at most 1 AND.
- AT MOST ~1/5 of them as precision queries — targeted structured queries using whichever fields from the reference best fit the co-required concepts (controlled vocabulary, entity, or section fields), at most 1 AND. When an exact answer exists, these find it.
